auditions-active-text: Auditions for the 2026-2027 school year will take place from Sunday, September 27th to Tuesday, September 29th. Callbacks will take place on Wednesday, September 30th by invitation only. We can't wait to hear you sing!
auditions-inactive-text: Auditions for the 2026-2027 school year have ended, but check back later for updates about auditioning for us next year!
